notes: THE CHAPEL OF ANTICIPATION RETURN (2026-08-25 ruling, #1023, on 255's tracker report): "chapel of anticipation return we can model as liurnia". f510030 is the Grafted Scion's drop (Ornamental Straight Sword + Golden Beast Crest Shield, lots 10030/10031) on the chapel floor, which is authored inside m10_01 -- that map's own EMEVD names the fight チュートリアルボス撃破 ("Defeat the tutorial boss"), $Event(10012800) sets 9103 on 10010800's death, and common.emevd $Event(1100) slot 3 pays lot 10030 under flag 510030. The grace join therefore reads m10_01 = Stormveil, and the old override read Limgrave (sphere 0, on the strength of the prologue pass). Both are wrong for ACCESS: the prologue pass is a one-shot the game expects you to lose, and the only repeatable route back to that floor is the Four Belfries -> Chapel warp, which stands in Liurnia (its Imbued Sword Key is the Liurnia check f1033477020, #940). Liurnia is the Lock that buys the warp; Limgrave's graces put you nowhere on that floor. NB the three non-tutorial m18_00 rows 255's report also suspected (18007900 Erdtree Greatbow, 510280 Golden Seed, 18007700 Dragon Communion Seal) are NOT chapel rows and stay Limgrave -- see the PR for #1023.
